note: Hashes of the EAGLE-I, Census and HURDAT2 downloads as they were when the committed tables and the lockbox run were built (2026-11-05 to 2026-11-09), and the row count of the EAGLE-I 2022 file. scripts/fetch_eaglei.py and scripts/reproduce.py compare fresh downloads, and an EAGLE-I parquet already on disk, with these, so a change in one of these files is reported as an input change. NASA's Black Marble tiles are NOT pinned: each download is checked only against the MD5 NASA lists for it that day, so a NASA reprocessing shows up as different numbers in the comparison. Update the values only when the tables are rebuilt from new inputs.
